FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
| STATS BY use_case_description

| KEEP `Anomaly Types`

FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.original_entity IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.item IS NOT NULL
| EVAL anomaly_detection = CONCAT(use_case_description, " | ", anomaly.original_entity)
| STATS
    `Anomalous_Items` = COUNT(anomaly.item),
    item_values = VALUES(anomaly.item),
    usecase_description_values = VALUES(use_case_description)

query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.original_entity IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.item IS NOT NULL
| EVAL anomaly_detection = CONCAT(use_case_description, " | ", anomaly.original_entity)
| STATS
    total_alerts           = COUNT(event.id),
    epoch_first_alert_time = MIN(@timestamp),
    epoch_last_alert_time  = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY anomaly_detection, anomaly.item
| EVAL
    first_alert_time = DATE_FORMAT("MMMM dd, hh:mm:ss a", epoch_first_alert_time),
    last_alert_time  = DATE_FORMAT("MMMM dd, hh:mm:ss a", epoch_last_alert_time)
| EVAL anomaly_summary = CONCAT(
    TO_STRING(total_alerts),
    " alerts for ",
    anomaly.item,
    " from ",
    first_alert_time,
    " to ",
    last_alert_time
  )
| SORT epoch_last_alert_time DESC
| KEEP anomaly_detection, anomaly_summary
| RENAME anomaly_detection AS Detections, anomaly_summary AS Summary

query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.item IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.original_entity IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.usecase IS NOT NULL
| EVAL use_case_normalized = CASE(
    anomaly.usecase == "server_ns_services", "ns_servers_services",
    anomaly.usecase == "server_ns_http", "http_user_agents",
    anomaly.usecase
  )
| EVAL entity_host = REPLACE(anomaly.original_entity, "/[0-9]{1,2}$", "")
| EVAL anomaly_behavior = CASE(
    use_case_normalized == "ssh_clients",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used SSH client ", anomaly.item, ", an SSH client they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "ew_servers_services",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used ", anomaly.item, ", a service they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "http_user_agents",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used ", anomaly.item, ", a user agent they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "ssh_connections",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " established an SSH connection to subnet ", anomaly.item, ", a destination they and similar entities had not connected to during baselining"),
    anomaly.item
  )
| STATS `Count of Alerts` = COUNT(anomaly.item) BY use_case_description, entity_host, anomaly_behavior
| SORT `Count of Alerts` DESC
| RENAME
    use_case_description AS `Anomaly Type`,
    anomaly_behavior AS `Anomaly Behavior`,
    entity_host AS `Anomalous Entity Host`

FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.item IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.original_entity IS NOT NULL
    AND anomaly.usecase IS NOT NULL
| EVAL use_case_normalized = CASE(
    anomaly.usecase == "server_ns_services", "ns_servers_services",
    anomaly.usecase == "server_ns_http", "http_user_agents",
    anomaly.usecase
  )
| EVAL entity_host = REPLACE(anomaly.original_entity, "/[0-9]{1,2}$", "")
| EVAL anomaly_behavior = CASE(
    use_case_normalized == "ssh_clients",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used SSH client ", anomaly.item, ", an SSH client they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "ew_servers_services",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used ", anomaly.item, ", a service they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "http_user_agents",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " used ", anomaly.item, ", a user agent they and similar entities had not used during baselining"),
    use_case_normalized == "ssh_connections",
      CONCAT(entity_host, " established an SSH connection to subnet ", anomaly.item, ", a destination they and similar entities had not connected to during baselining"),
    anomaly.item
  )
| STATS `Count of Alerts` = COUNT(anomaly.item) BY use_case_description, entity_host, anomaly_behavior
| SORT `Count of Alerts` DESC
| RENAME
    use_case_description AS `Anomaly Type`,
    anomaly_behavior AS `Anomaly Behavior`,
    entity_host AS `Anomalous Entity Host`

query.esql:
FROM logs-corelight.various-*
| WHERE event.dataset == "anomaly"
    AND observer.hostname IS NOT NULL
    AND use_case_description IS NOT NULL
| EVAL display_entity = REPLACE(anomaly.original_entity, "/[0-9]{1,2}$", "")
| EVAL `Alert Timestamp` = DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", @timestamp)
| EVAL `Services during Baseline` = MV_CONCAT(MV_DEDUPE(anomaly.entity_training_items), ", ")
| EVAL `Engine Confidence` = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(anomaly.item_score), 2)
| RENAME
    display_entity AS `Anomalous Entity Host`,
    anomaly.item AS `Anomalous Service`,
    anomaly.entity AS `Anomalous Entity`,
    event.id AS `uid`
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP `Alert Timestamp`, `Anomalous Entity Host`, `Anomalous Service`, `Services during Baseline`, `Anomalous Entity`, `Engine Confidence`, `uid`
